Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how BOSS Content Studio may collect, use, and handle information in connection with its content preparation, scheduling, and publishing service. BOSS Content Studio is an early-stage product; this policy will be updated as the service develops.

Information you may provide

Depending on available features, information may include account and authentication details, profile information, social-platform authorization data, content and media you choose to provide, scheduling and publishing metadata, and storage-provider connection data where applicable.

How we use information

Information may be used to operate and improve the service; prepare, schedule, upload, or publish content at your direction; maintain connected accounts and storage workspaces; provide support; protect the service; and understand service reliability through service and diagnostic information.

Connected platforms and providers

When you connect a third-party platform or storage provider, BOSS Content Studio may process information made available through that connection to provide the features you request. Your use of connected services is also governed by their own terms and privacy practices. We do not imply that any platform endorses or approves BOSS Content Studio.

OAuth and authorization

Where available, connected-platform access is expected to use the platform's authorization process. We may retain authorization records or tokens as needed to maintain a connection and perform requested actions. You can disconnect a platform connection through available service controls; this may stop future access while records needed for operational, security, or legal reasons may be retained as described below.

Data retention

We may retain information for as long as reasonably needed to provide the service, maintain records of service activity, resolve disputes, meet legal obligations, and protect the service. Retention practices may change as the product evolves.

Security

We use reasonable measures intended to protect information, but no system or transmission can be guaranteed completely secure. Please use care when selecting content and connections for the service and protect your account credentials.

Your choices

You may choose what content, accounts, and providers to connect. Where account controls are available, you may update or disconnect those connections. Additional access, correction, or deletion options may be made available as the product enters beta.

Children and minors

BOSS Content Studio is not directed to children. Do not use the service or provide personal information if you are not old enough to do so under applicable law.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as the service changes. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised date.

Contact

Support and contact information will be available as BOSS Content Studio enters beta.
